# Invoicerr

> Open-source invoicing app (AGPL-3.0): quotes, invoices, payments and e-invoicing to the tax office. Country rules ship for France, Germany, Italy, Poland and Portugal. Self-host it free with Docker or Helm, or use the hosted cloud version.

This site's full text, home page and every page below, is in [llms-full.txt](https://invoicerr.app/llms-full.txt). The product documentation has its own index at [docs.invoicerr.app/llms.txt](https://docs.invoicerr.app/llms.txt).

## Product

- [Product](https://invoicerr.app/#product): from quote to invoice, payment matching and legal archive
- [Countries](https://invoicerr.app/#countries): what the app asks and sends for each supported country
- [Self-hosting](https://invoicerr.app/#hosting): Docker image for amd64, arm64 and arm/v7, and a Helm chart
- [Pricing](https://invoicerr.app/#pricing): per-company cloud pricing, self-hosting free

## Guides

In French, for a French audience — no product comparison, every date and threshold sourced to the
legal text or the tax administration.

- [Facturation électronique en France](https://invoicerr.app/facturation-electronique): who must receive and issue electronic invoices, from when by company size, what a PDP is, accepted formats and archiving duration

## Docs

- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://docs.invoicerr.app/llms.txt): every documentation page, with a summary
- [Docker installation](https://docs.invoicerr.app/docs/user-guide/docker-installation): the recommended way to self-host
- [Country support matrix](https://docs.invoicerr.app/docs/developer-guide/country-support): identifiers, VAT rates, formats and channels per country
- [API reference](https://docs.invoicerr.app/docs/developer-guide/api-reference)
